description: This file defines a React component named 'Switch' which renders a toggle switch UI element with optional tooltip support. It manages its checked state internally and notifies parent components of changes via a callback prop.

classes.name: Switch
classes.description: A React component representing a toggle switch with optional tooltip support, managing its own checked state and handling user interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component's state based on props.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates the internal checked state if the checked prop changes.

methods.name: _onChange
methods.description: Handles change events from the checkbox input, updates state, and calls callback if provided.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the switch component with optional tooltip and label.
